text:
maria: Heads up — we have an ongoing incident in eu-west-1 impacting model-serving KV cache behavior. Observed tail latency spikes and intermittent 503s on long sequences. Please DO NOT promote or run new canaries against eu-west-1 for the next 2h. Pin current model version on prod routes. @deploy-bot can you quarantine scheduled rollouts targeting eu-*?

deploy-bot: ✅ pausing scheduled rollouts for targets matching eu-* (all environments). Links: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0387 · runbook: https://runbooks.internal/kv-cache-eviction 

alex: Is this regional only or are global fallbacks affected too? Any user-facing errors?

jamal: Regional only so far. Global replicas are fine, but requests routed to eu-west-1 with long sequences see 95th spike and occasional 503. Telemetry: spike at 11:07 UTC, correlates with cache pressure. I'm on-call and digging in.

ops-lead: Agree with pause. Suggest we pin prod model to v1.7.2 and rollback any canary that landed in eu yesterday (2026-04-05-rc). Also shift the change window until we validate.

maria: +1 to pin and rollback. I'll update the release notes and notify stakeholders.

deploy-bot: To pin a route:```sh
# pin route to model version
redwood routes pin --route prod/chat --model v1.7.2
# rollback canary
redwood deploy rollback --id 2026-04-05-rc --scope eu-west-1
```

sre-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-0387 (severity: sev2). Triage channel: #incidents. Oncall: jamal. Runbook step 1 executed.

jamal: Starting cache heap dump + kernel-level tracing now. ETA for initial mitigation signal ~30m. Can we move the change window to 10:00 UTC+1 and re-evaluate at +2h? Would rather avoid a surprise rollout while we triage.

alex: If teams have long-running perf tests pointed at eu, please stop them — they'll just make noise.

ops-lead: I'll set release window block and enable automatic fallback to global for impacted routes.

deploy-bot: Locks applied: release-window blocked for all releases targeting eu-* until 2165008534 (approx 2h). Canary promotions disabled for eu targets.

maria: Thanks everyone. I will post a short update to #product and email ops@ with the pin/rollback notes. We will only resume deployments after 30m of stable SLOs post-mitigation. :thumbsup:

jamal: will report back in 20 with first findings.

ops-lead: copying runbook steps to the release doc so it's visible to PMs and CS.

maria: Closing thread when incident is resolved. For now consider this thread the source of truth for release coordination.
